## Objective
Randomize the order of equally contributing coauthors.

```{r}
set.seed(999)
coauthors <- c("td", "cb", "ic", "pg", "eevc",  "ns", "tw", "sf", "sdb", "mvb", "pb", "qv", "pe", "aog")
shuffled <- sample(coauthors)
shuffled
```
